spec.title: graph2otel Teams
spec.description: Microsoft Teams call, site and service health. Generated from grafana/boards/teams.py.

spec.name: datasource
spec.label: Prometheus datasource
spec.description: Where graph2otel's OTLP metrics land after normalization. Defaults to Grafana Cloud's grafanacloud-prom; pick another Prometheus datasource for a different stack.

spec.name: loki_datasource
spec.label: Loki datasource
spec.description: Required by the log panels. Defaults to Grafana Cloud's grafanacloud-logs. Leave unset and they say so rather than looking broken.

spec.name: tenant
spec.label: Tenant
spec.description: Select the polled tenant; All includes unlabelled single-tenant signals.

spec.name: call_id
spec.label: Call ID
spec.description: Required on Call detail; follows links from call or stream rows.

spec.name: site
spec.label: Site
spec.description: Exact configured name, either stream side. Used by the Calls site results only.

spec.name: user
spec.label: User UPN
spec.description: Exact observed UPN; call rows check organiser, stream rows check either side.

spec.name: health
spec.label: Call health
spec.description: Exact emitted value (good, poor, or unclassified). Blank means all.

spec.name: call_type
spec.label: Call type
spec.description: Exact Graph type, e.g. peerToPeer or groupCall. Blank means all.

spec.name: modality
spec.label: Modality
spec.description: Exact Graph modality token, e.g. audio or video. Blank means all.

spec.name: min_seconds
spec.label: Minimum duration (seconds)
spec.description: Whole seconds. Blank means all, including unknown duration.

options.content: Use **Calls** for emitted versions and **Call detail** to review the evidence. Home and site metrics describe first accepted complete versions. Log timestamps are source timestamps; metric counters and rates follow collection time. Unique callers are not available as a bounded aggregate; endpoint rows are not a substitute.

spec.title: Calls counted in range
spec.description: Health counts the first accepted complete version and is not rewritten by later versions. Prometheus estimates the counter increase over the selected range from scraped samples. This is processing time, not a count of Loki rows by call start time.

spec.expr: sum by (tenant_id) (increase(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Good share of classified calls
spec.description: Health counts the first accepted complete version and is not rewritten by later versions. Unclassified calls are excluded. No classified observations means no percentage.

spec.expr: (((sum by (tenant_id) (increase(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",call_health="good"}[$__range]))) or on (tenant_id) (0 * (sum by (tenant_id) (increase(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",call_health=~"good|poor"}[$__range]))))) / (sum by (tenant_id) (increase(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",call_health=~"good|poor"}[$__range])))) and on (tenant_id) ((sum by (tenant_id) (increase(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",call_health=~"good|poor"}[$__range]))) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Call rate by initial health
spec.description: Health counts the first accepted complete version and is not rewritten by later versions.

spec.expr: sum by (tenant_id, call_health) (rate(teams_calls_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Later call health transition rate
spec.description: Changes between successive accepted versions. Not a signed correction to the initial counts.

spec.expr: sum by (tenant_id, from_health, to_health) (rate(teams_call_health_transitions_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Teams users by platform (D7)
spec.description: From the Teams usage report. A user may appear on several platforms; do not sum them.

spec.expr: avg by (tenant_id, platform) (teams_device_usage_users{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Recently ended calls by client bucket
spec.description: Calls in the latest 60 call-end minutes since process start. Client buckets overlap.

spec.expr: sum by (tenant_id, platform, product_family, version_bucket) (teams_client_versions{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})

defaults.noValue: No metric rows. Check Signal availability above: this result alone is not evidence that the collector is disabled, healthy, or failed. A datasource or query error is shown separately.

spec.title: Observed caller sites
spec.description:
Location from the configured site mapping, when seen on a stream. Not the full configured inventory. Up to 250 recent records in the selected time range, not a census.

Needs a **Loki** datasource (selected above). Log attributes are Loki *structured metadata*, not stream labels: filter with `| event_name=…` after `{service_name="graph2otel"}`. A stream selector on an attribute matches zero rows silently (#90).

spec.expr: {service_name="graph2otel"} | event_name=`teams.call_stream` | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | caller_site!~`unmapped|` | caller_site_latitude!=`` | caller_site_longitude!=`` | keep tenant_id, caller_site, caller_site_country, caller_site_latitude, caller_site_longitude

defaults.noValue: No rows. Either no Loki datasource is selected above, or nothing matched. Log attributes are structured metadata: filter with | attr=… after {service_name="graph2otel"}, never {attr="…"}.

spec.expr: {service_name="graph2otel"} | event_name=`teams.call_stream` | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | caller_site_latitude!=`` | caller_site_longitude!=`` | keep tenant_id, caller_site, caller_site_latitude, caller_site_longitude

defaults.noValue: No rows. Either no Loki datasource is selected above, or nothing matched. Log attributes are structured metadata: filter with | attr=… after {service_name="graph2otel"}, never {attr="…"}.

options.content: The call table filters by health, type, modality, organiser UPN and minimum duration. Site is only recorded on stream sides. Use **Call IDs observed at the selected site** when a site is entered, then follow the call ID to details. The general call table is inactive during a site search. Site results match an optional user against either stream side; call health, type, modality and duration filters only apply to the general call table. Both views can show multiple versions.

spec.title: Call records
spec.description:
Up to 250 recent records in the selected time range, not a census.

Needs a **Loki** datasource (selected above). Log attributes are Loki *structured metadata*, not stream labels: filter with `| event_name=…` after `{service_name="graph2otel"}`. A stream selector on an attribute matches zero rows silently (#90).

spec.expr: {service_name="graph2otel"} | event_name=`teams.call` | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | label_format g2o_match=`{{if and .call_id (eq "${site:percentencode}" "")}}yes{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | label_format g2o_match=`{{if eq "${health:percentencode}" ""}}yes{{else}}{{if (eq (.call_health | urlquery | replace "+" "%20") "${health:percentencode}")}}yes{{end}}{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | label_format g2o_match=`{{if eq "${call_type:percentencode}" ""}}yes{{else}}{{if (eq (.call_type | urlquery | replace "+" "%20") "${call_type:percentencode}")}}yes{{end}}{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | label_format g2o_match=`{{if eq "${modality:percentencode}" ""}}yes{{else}}{{range fromJson .modalities}}{{if eq (. | urlquery | replace "+" "%20") "${modality:percentencode}"}}yes{{break}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | label_format g2o_match=`{{if eq "${user:percentencode}" ""}}yes{{else}}{{if (eq (.organizer_user_principal_name | urlquery | replace "+" "%20") "${user:percentencode}")}}yes{{end}}{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | label_format g2o_match=`{{if eq "${min_seconds:percentencode}" ""}}yes{{else if and (eq (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+$" "${min_seconds:percentencode}" "") "") .duration_seconds (ge (float64 .duration_seconds) (float64 "${min_seconds:percentencode}"))}}yes{{end}}` | g2o_match="yes" | drop g2o_match | keep tenant_id, call_id, version, call_health, call_type, modalities, organizer_user_principal_name, duration_seconds, start_time, end_time

defaults.noValue: No rows. Either no Loki datasource is selected above, or nothing matched. Log attributes are structured metadata: filter with | attr=… after {service_name="graph2otel"}, never {attr="…"}.

options.content: Open a call from **Calls**, or select its tenant and enter a call ID. Compare like versions. Missing fields mean unavailable observations; they do not indicate a good endpoint. Relay addresses are allocations, not proof of relay use. Trace rows are reported hops only.

spec.title: Signal availability

Intentional absence is disabled (transport_not_configured, experimental_not_enabled, high_volume_not_enabled, disabled_by_config, profile_not_selected) or covered (covered_by_alternative). healthy_empty/empty is a successful zero-row source response. limited/partial_license is non-failure; blocked/license_unavailable identifies a missing entitlement, while blocked/permission_denied requires access. degraded and failed (including source_error) describe completed runtime outcomes; startup_failed describes initialization failure.
